SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices and delivers them ready to use across Jalandhar. We build each unit to order at our own ISO-certified factory and dispatch it fitted — walls, flooring, wiring, windows and doors done — to the Focal Point industrial area, the Industrial Estate on the GT Road bypass and export units across the city. You deal with the maker, not a reseller or a marketplace listing. For models, sizes and finishes, see our full Container Office Supplier for Jalandhar Focal Point range, then send your requirement for a quote.

A container office is a steel-framed office cabin built inside a container-style shell. Because it arrives finished, your team can move in the day it lands — no site masonry, no wet work and no long build wait. In an export city like Jalandhar, that lets a sports goods or hand tools unit add an admin room, a dispatch office or a gate cabin during an expansion without stopping production.

Who buys a container office in Jalandhar

Jalandhar is one of India's best-known export manufacturing cities — sports goods, hand tools, rubber goods and leather units. Most of our enquiries here come from:

  • Sports goods and hand tools export units needing an admin, sampling or documentation office
  • Focal Point and Industrial Estate units needing a supervisor or stores cabin
  • Factories needing a dispatch and packing supervision office near the loading bay
  • Units needing a gate and security office at the entrance

Every unit we supply is an administrative, dispatch or gate cabin — a clean, insulated workspace. We do not market these as process, tannery or hazardous-area structures.

Where we deliver in and around Jalandhar

We supply container offices across the main industrial pockets of Jalandhar:

  • Focal Point Industrial Area — 144004
  • Industrial Town and the Industrial Estate on the GT Road bypass — 144004
  • Jalandhar city and nearby project sites — 144001

These belts run on sports goods, hand tools, rubber and leather manufacturing — export units that often need a clean office added quickly beside a working shed. Share your exact plot and gate access, and we confirm the delivery plan with the quotation.

Which container office suits your Jalandhar site

Different jobs call for different cabins. As a guide:

  • A gate or single-desk security point — a 10 ft cabin
  • An admin, sampling or dispatch office — a 20 ft cabin, the most common choice
  • A larger office with a meeting or record area — a 40 ft cabin, which can be partitioned
  • A unit expanding across sites — a mobile container office for export-unit expansions

Container office sizes

SizeTypical useNotes
10 ftGate office or single supervisor cabinCompact, single door
20 ftAdmin, sampling or dispatch officeMost common for export units
40 ftLarge office with meeting or record areaCan be partitioned

Internal usable area and layout are confirmed at quotation, since we build to order rather than from stock.

Materials and construction

Every container office we ship to Jalandhar is built to the same factory standard:

  • Structural frame in MS steel to IS 2062 grade
  • Wall and roof options in PUF sandwich panel or cement/fibre board with a GI sheet roof
  • PUF insulation to hold heat down in summer and warmth in during Punjab winters
  • Ply-and-vinyl flooring, aluminium sliding windows, and steel or laminated doors
  • Electrical points, lighting and a distribution board wired to your layout

Exact panel thickness, wiring load and fittings are set to your spec. Anything non-standard is marked "confirm at quotation" so the price you get is honest.

Customisation options

We fit each cabin to how your unit works. Common additions for Jalandhar sites include AC provision, internal partitions, an attached toilet, a pantry point, extra windows, a document-storage area, company colour and branding, and an entry ramp or platform. List what you need and it goes into the quote.

Delivery from our Greater Noida factory

Jalandhar is served from our Greater Noida factory on North-zone dispatch. The road route runs up the GT Road corridor on NH44 via Panipat, Ambala and Ludhiana — roughly 420–450 km depending on your plot. Transit is typically within our standard 3–5 day window after the unit is built and dispatched. Default delivery is ₹3,000 where applicable; the exact freight and any crane offloading are confirmed on the quotation. Returns follow our 7-day, customer-paid return policy.

Planning across the wider corridor? See container offices we build for Ludhiana's MSME belt, container offices we send to the Chandigarh Tricity, and container offices we supply through Delhi NCR.

Documentation for export-unit buyers

Export units in Jalandhar need clean paperwork for their own audits and buyer inspections. As a registered Private Limited manufacturer, we issue a proper GST invoice (GSTIN 09ABBCS7101B1ZT) and an e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration. This keeps procurement and audit straightforward.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 and has been incorporated since 2019, with 500+ projects delivered. We are certified to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our units carry a 5-year warranty on the structural frame and base and 1–2 years on finishing, with a 20–25 year engineered service life.

Price factors for a container office in Jalandhar

We quote to your spec rather than a fixed figure, because the price moves with size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and plumbing fit-out, an attached toilet, quantity and the delivery distance to Jalandhar. Send your requirement and we return a clear, itemised quote — no guesswork, no hidden add-ons.

Frequently asked questions

What does a container office cost in Jalandhar?

There is no single fixed price. The cost depends on size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and toilet fit-out, quantity and the delivery distance to your Jalandhar site. Share your requirement and we send an itemised quote the same way for every buyer.

Do you deliver to Focal Point and the Industrial Estate?

Yes. We dispatch from our Greater Noida factory up NH44 via Panipat, Ambala and Ludhiana to the Focal Point industrial area (144004), the Industrial Town and Industrial Estate belt (144004) and Jalandhar city (144001) — about 420–450 km. We confirm the schedule and offloading with your quote.

Which size suits a sports goods or hand tools export unit?

A 20 ft cabin covers most admin, sampling and dispatch needs, a 10 ft cabin suits a gate or single-desk point, and a 40 ft cabin suits a larger office with a meeting area. Layouts are customised and confirmed at quotation.

Do you provide a GST invoice and e-way bill for vendor onboarding?

Yes. We are a GST-registered Private Limited manufacturer and issue a GST invoice and e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration.

Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your container office in Jalandhar, or send an enquiry with your size and site details for a quote.
